in_sanskrit.name: Lakshin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mark, symbol, goal
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lakshin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'laksh', meaning 'goal' or 'mark'. In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity, is often depicted with a lotus in her hand, representing the goal or mark of attaining enlightenment and spiritual growth.
